args.message:
Here are the customer, credit-limit and order totals for each region. The order counts add up to all 5,016 orders.

| Region | Customers | Credit limit total | Orders |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| North | 59 | 35,740 | 1,613 |
| South | 65 | 32,650 | 1,584 |
| East | 44 | 24,920 | 1,053 |
| West | 33 | 18,020 | 750 |
| (no region) | 1 | 500 | 16 |

- **No-region group:** One customer has no known region. Their orders are counted in this group, along with orders that have no matching customer. The 16 orders weren't split any further.
- **Arctic:** This region has no customers, so it's left out.
- **How the counts were made:** Customers were counted directly, so customers who never placed an order are included. Orders were counted separately and linked to a region through their customer.
